triage.note:
ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. Chevron FY2015 items 7 and 8 read, in full: item 7 -- 'Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

The index to Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, Consolidated Financial Statements and Supplementary Data is presented on page FS-1.' (280 chars); item 8 -- 'Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data

The index to Management's Discussion and Analysis, Consolidated Financial Statements and Supplementary Data is presented on page FS-1.' (189 chars). Both report status=extracted, confidence=0.95. The actual MD&A and financial statements are real content sitting in this SAME document's tail -- 294,291 chars outside every item span (16 'FS-1' hits, 18 'Consolidated Statement of Income' hits, 2 auditor reports) -- reached only by resolving 'page FS-1', an internal pagination reference, not an external-document pointer. WHY IT IS NOT FIXED: ADR-004 rules that an internal pointer cannot make an item `incorporated_by_reference` -- correct, since nothing is actually incorporated from outside the document, there is nothing to fetch. That leaves the pointer paragraph itself as the item's only body, which is non-empty ordinary prose (not the ba-2003 empty-body shape), so ADR-005's rules pass it through as `extracted` at full confidence with nothing to object to at the single-item level classify() operates at. Closing the gap would mean resolving an intra-document page/pagination reference ('page FS-1') to find and attach the real content -- a new capability, forbidden by the T8 freeze, not a defect in an existing layer. The two asserted min_chars checks encode what would be true if that capability existed (the real MD&A/financial-statement text, not just the one-sentence pointer, ends up in the span) and are expected to stay red until a post-freeze ADR admits the capability. WHY THIS IS A DISTINCT VARIANT, NOT A DUPLICATE OF ba-2003: ba-2003 items 11/13 have a genuinely empty body (34/59 chars, heading + page furniture only) and the missing reference is a footnote naming OTHER items in the SAME document; wfc-2008 (ADR-017, already fixed) was an EXTERNAL pointer whose phrasing simply didn't match IBR_RE. cvx-2015 items 7/8 have a non-empty, well-formed pointer sentence whose destination is an internal page number in THIS document's own tail -- the short_span check (floor 100) does not fire (280/189 chars, well clear of the floor), and low_span_coverage DID fire in the stdlib oracle but was triaged away as 'exhibit attachments', the same story that correctly explains ge-1994's pension-note tail and incorrectly explains this one (see the planning-pass audit, scratchpad t11-my-audit.md section C, for the full triage-of-a-true-positive writeup). STANDING DISAGREEMENT, RECORDED NOT RESOLVED: the extraction-auditor's independent blind sample (docs/evals/audits/2026-08-19-t11-silent-failure-sample.md, item #21) adjudicated cvx-2015 item 6 -- 'Item 6. Selected Financial Data

The selected financial data for years 2011 through 2015 are presented on page FS-60.' -- the identical shape (short pointer body, internal page reference, real content in the document tail) -- and ruled it CORRECT. That verdict was never reconciled against this same planning pass's reading of items 7/8 as the silent-failure shape this repo exists to hunt; items 7 and 8 themselves were never independently adjudicated by the auditor (they were outside its 30-case sample). This case therefore asserts the debt for items 7/8 only, not item 6 -- resolving the item-6 disagreement by assertion would violate the auditor's own charter for a standing disagreement between two independent reads of the same shape. Sibling instance noted for the record, not covered by a case here: ge-1994 item 8 (86 chars, 'See index under item 14.') is the same internal-pointer-to-paginated-section shape one era earlier.

provenance: T11 (2026-08-19), authored from the T11 planning-pass audit (scratchpad t11-my-audit.md, finding B) against evals/fixtures/cvx-2015/filing.htm. Item 7's span [112426,112706) and item 8's span [113159,113348) verified directly against src.sec10k.extract.extract_items('evals/fixtures/cvx-2015/filing.htm')['normalized_text'] (HTML fixture; verified via the pipeline's own canon-correct rendering rather than raw-byte grep, same method as msft-2013-content.json and wmt-2010-shallow.json's T11 addition, since the fixture is HTML and the pointer sentences are split across tags in the raw bytes). Document length 417,523 chars; 'FS-1' appears 23 times and 'Consolidated Statement of Income' 19 times in normalized_text, none of them inside any item's span -- confirming the real content is outside every span, not merely under-measured. The three invariant checks (no_empty_success, no_overlap_ordered, verbatim) are there so this case still notices if the fixture's spans stop being well-formed, exactly as in ba-2003-asterisk-ibr.json; the item_present checks pin status=extracted as the correct, unchanged call per ADR-004 (a bookkeeping check, not part of the debt -- it would fail loudly if some future change wrongly reclassified these items rather than closing the real gap). The two min_chars checks are the whole of the debt. If they ever go green the runner says 'NOW GREEN -- promote it'.
